08323 sarar {saw-rar'}

字根型; TWOT - 2295; 動詞

欽定本 - rule 3, make prince 1, altogether 1; 5

1) 舉止如王子, 管理, 主張, 有權柄, 戰勝,
   掌管, 統治
   1a) (Qal) 管理, 治理
   1b) (Hithpael) 統管(支配) (#民 16:13|)
record.edic_text:
08323 sarar {saw-rar'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 2295; v

AV - rule 3, make prince 1, altogether 1; 5

1) to be or act as prince, rule, contend, have power, prevail over,
   reign, govern
   1a) (Qal) to rule over, govern
   1b) (Hithpael) to lord it over
